say:1:1621130001:1.text: I see. The good jelly was enchanted to hide the scent of sleepweed.
say:1:1621130001:1.source_cn: ……原来如此。也就是说，质量合格的魔力甜甜冻被施加了魔...
say:1:1621130001:1.male: I see. The good jelly was enchanted to hide the scent of sleepweed.
say:1:1621130001:1.female: I see. The good jelly was enchanted to hide the scent of sleepweed.

say:2:1621130002:1.text: These defective ones weren't, so the smell is leaking out...
say:2:1621130002:1.source_cn: 这批劣质果冻的加工出了点问题，没有遮掩催眠草的味道……
say:2:1621130002:1.male: These defective ones weren't, so the smell is leaking out...
say:2:1621130002:1.female: These defective ones weren't, so the smell is leaking out...

say:3:1621130003:1.text: No wonder Anzel scrambled to retrieve every defective batch. He wasn't worried about anyone getting sick—he was terrified the truth would come out.
say:3:1621130003:1.source_cn: 难怪安泽急着把劣质果冻收回来——不是怕人吃坏了，而是怕...
say:3:1621130003:1.male: No wonder Anzel scrambled to retrieve every defective batch. He wasn't worried about anyone getting sick—he was terrified the truth would come out.
say:3:1621130003:1.female: No wonder Anzel scrambled to retrieve every defective batch. He wasn't worried about anyone getting sick—he was terrified the truth would come out.

say:4:1621130004:1.text: All that talk about "heightened focus" and "boosted senses"... it was all an illusion.
say:4:1621130004:1.source_cn: 所谓的“提神”“增强感知”，从头到尾都是一场幻觉。
say:4:1621130004:1.male: All that talk about "heightened focus" and "boosted senses"... it was all an illusion.
say:4:1621130004:1.female: All that talk about "heightened focus" and "boosted senses"... it was all an illusion.

say:5:1621130005:1.text: The students weren't getting any stronger. They were just led to believe they were. They were addicted to the feeling, not the power.
say:5:1621130005:1.source_cn: 那些学生并没有真正变强，他们只是被引导着相信自己变强了...
say:5:1621130005:1.male: The students weren't getting any stronger. They were just led to believe they were. They were addicted to the feeling, not the power.
say:5:1621130005:1.female: The students weren't getting any stronger. They were just led to believe they were. They were addicted to the feeling, not the power.

say:6:1621130006:1.text: And even if the jelly did nothing, as long as that illusion felt real, they'd give up everything they owned just for another taste.
say:6:1621130006:1.source_cn: 哪怕这果冻一无是处，只要那错觉足够真实，就能让人心甘情...
say:6:1621130006:1.male: And even if the jelly did nothing, as long as that illusion felt real, they'd give up everything they owned just for another taste.
say:6:1621130006:1.female: And even if the jelly did nothing, as long as that illusion felt real, they'd give up everything they owned just for another taste.

say:7:1621130007:1.text: But this thing... it's not a commodity. It's incriminating evidence.
say:7:1621130007:1.source_cn: 可这东西……终究不是能流通的商品，而是罪证。
say:7:1621130007:1.male: But this thing... it's not a commodity. It's incriminating evidence.
say:7:1621130007:1.female: But this thing... it's not a commodity. It's incriminating evidence.
